children: Craig Conway, a Director, reported two direct sales of Salesforce common stock on 2026-09-04 at a weighted average price of $260.4958 for one lot and $260.6629 for the other. The filer disclosed that the first lot’s weighted average price reflects multiple trades between $260.4700 and $260.5000 and offered to provide details on request.
